data.gender_notes: Karbhari is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Karbhari is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Karpa' meaning 'strong' and 'Bhari' meaning 'bearer'. This name is often given to boys who are believed to possess great strength and the ability to bear heavy responsibilities. The name Karbhari carries the meaning “Strong, Powerful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Karbhari usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
